description: This PHP script serves as an error page handler for the TestLink project. It initializes request arguments, prepares GUI data based on error messages, and renders a template using the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A standard PHP empty class used for generic object property storage.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing an error message based on the 'code' request parameter.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Prepares GUI data object with message content for display.
